q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance salt_bloom pale) carries (STV 1.0 0.9), but strength 1.0 is licensed only by an explicit all/every quantifier or by a definitional claim (which takes confidence 0.99); a bare generic at empirical confidence takes strength 0.9.
(Inheritance salt_bloom crystalline) has the same unlicensed 1.0/0.9 pairing - it should be either 0.9 0.9 as a bare empirical generic or 1.0 0.99 as definitional, not a mix of the two dials.

notes: Kind subject to Inheritance, the salt_bloom genus with the noun modifier suppressed, crystalline kept in its derived form, and the two descriptive adjectives split out instead of fused are all correct; only the two property atoms deviate on truth values.
